interface.title: HED online tools (Hierarchical Event Descriptors web services)
interface.field: Neuroimaging / electrophysiology data curation (EEG, MEG, iEEG, fMRI; BIDS datasets)
interface.stage_of_work: Data annotation and curation before sharing a dataset, plus later reuse of annotated event data in analysis
interface.what_it_is_for: Web forms where you upload event tables, JSON sidecars, tagging spreadsheets, HED strings or HED schemas, pick a HED schema version, and get back validation reports, assembled per-event annotations, query results, converted tags or sidecar templates.

data.note: Used bids_events.tsv with bids_events.json and with bids_events_bad.json (which has the bad tag 'BlechDrawing'), sub-002_ses-1_task-FacePerception_run-1_events.tsv with task-FacePerception_events.json, SpreadsheetTest.tsv and def_test.json, plus HED strings I typed in. The Schemas page loaded HED 8.4.0 and 8.3.0 from its default GitHub URLs, and the server fetched them without trouble. Most results come back as downloaded files (.txt reports, .tsv, .json, .zip) with a coloured status bar on the page; the Strings page shows results in a Results text box instead.

features.name: Action-switched processing form
features.general: Pick an operation from one dropdown; the form shows only the inputs and options that operation needs, then runs it on the uploaded files and returns a status bar plus a downloadable result
features.specific: The Action select on the Events page swaps the inputs: Validate shows Check warnings and Limit errors; Check HED quality shows Show error details and Limit errors; Assemble HED annotations shows Append assembled, Include context, Replace defs and No condition or task; Search HED adds a HED query box; Generate JSON sidecar template hides the sidecar and schema and shows a column table. Process returns a green or orange message and downloads a report. The list also offers Execute remodel script, whose inputs were not examined
steps: choose an action in the Action dropdown
watch option toggles and input fields appear or disappear
set the toggles
press Process
read the coloured status bar and open the downloaded file
serves_tasks: Validate an event table together with its metadata file
Expand each event row into its full annotation
Find which events match a condition expressed as a query
Check annotations for completeness beyond strict validity

features.name: Column picker for template generation
features.general: List a table's columns with their number of unique values; tick which to include and whether each is categorical or numeric, then generate a metadata template
features.specific: The Generate JSON sidecar template table on the Events page: Include? and Categorical? checkboxes per column (e.g. event_type (7)). It produces a sidecar with Levels/HED entries for categorical columns and '#' value placeholders for others
steps: upload the events .tsv
choose Generate JSON sidecar template
tick Include for the wanted columns
tick Categorical for the coded columns
press Process and download the JSON
serves_tasks: Create a metadata template from an event table's columns

features.name: Versioned validation with issue report
features.general: Validate data files against a chosen version of a controlled vocabulary and get an error report grouped by column and value
features.specific: Tabular + Sidecar + Definitions upload slots, a Schema version dropdown (8.0.0-8.5.0 and library schemas), Check warnings and Limit errors toggles. The issue report .txt is grouped by column and key, with error codes such as TAG_INVALID and DEF_INVALID
steps: upload the events file and sidecar
pick the schema version
toggle Check warnings or Limit errors
press Process
read the status bar and the downloaded issues report
serves_tasks: Validate an event table together with its metadata file
Validate a metadata file that contains an unknown term and read the error report
Repeat the validation for each recording's event table and metadata
Validate a metadata file on its own

features.name: Query search over annotated events
features.general: Write a boolean or group query over annotation terms and get, for each row of a table, whether it matches; or test a single annotation
features.specific: The HED query box (Events page, Search HED) returns a _queries.tsv with a 0/1 query_0 column. The Strings page's HED search query box reports 'String satisfies the query'
steps: choose Search HED
type a query such as 'Sensory-event && Visual-presentation' or '{Face, Red}'
press Process
read the match column or the Results text
serves_tasks: Find which events match a condition expressed as a query
Test whether one annotation matches a query

features.name: Live string checker with results box
features.general: Type an annotation, pick a vocabulary version and an operation, and see errors or the converted form straight away in a text box, then edit and re-run
features.specific: Strings page: 'Enter a HED string' textarea, Action (Validate / Convert to long / Convert to short / Search HED), an optional Definitions JSON, a Schema dropdown and a Results textarea
steps: type a HED string
pick the schema version
choose Validate, Convert or Search
press Process
read Results and edit the string
press Process again
serves_tasks: Check a single typed annotation for correctness
Test whether one annotation matches a query

features.name: Two-source vocabulary comparison
features.general: Load two versions of a vocabulary, each from a URL, a file or a folder, and download a categorised list of differences
features.specific: Schemas page, Compare HED schemas: Source schema and Schema to compare panels, each with radio buttons for Schema URL, Schema file or Schema folder (only URL was used). Process downloads a differences.txt with changes marked Major, Minor or Patch
steps: choose Compare HED schemas
pick the source type for each panel with the radio buttons
enter the URL or upload a file for each
press Process
read the downloaded differences file
serves_tasks: List differences between two vocabulary versions

features.name: Tag-form conversion across file types
features.general: Rewrite the annotation terms in a metadata file, a lookup spreadsheet or a typed annotation into their full-hierarchy form with one shared action
features.specific: Convert to long on the Sidecars page (downloads _long_tag.json), the Spreadsheets page (downloads _to_long.tsv) and the Strings page (full paths shown in Results). On Spreadsheets, switching the action clears the chosen file, so re-upload before Process. Convert to short is offered on the Strings page but was not run
steps: open the page for the file type
choose Convert to long in the Action dropdown
upload the file (or type the string), re-uploading if the action switch cleared it
press Process
open the converted download or read Results
